title: Know Thyself, Know Thy Enemy
content_zh:
Sun Tzu's final principle: Know the enemy and know yourself.
In a hundred battles you will never be in peril.
When you are ignorant of the enemy but know yourself,
Your chances of winning or losing are equal.
If ignorant both of your enemy and of yourself,
You are certain in every battle to be in peril.
The skillful strategist is like a serpent of Shu Mountain.
Strike its head, and its tail attacks.
Strike its tail, and its head attacks.
Strike its middle, and both head and tail attack.
